fusions.name: Lock-Jawed
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 20 damage, holds the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Loosed Pack
fusions.desc: Slips a pack that deals 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 2 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you, up to 32%. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Rebaited
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Hound That Holds
fusions.desc: A bonded hound runs with you and bites enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it bites moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.
